name: Rinjani Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Lombok (lesser sundas)
description: A small brown owl with feathered ear tufts and yellow eyes, restricted to Lombok. Mostly brown with scattered white and pale markings on wings, sparsely streaked underparts, and a clear “double” facial disk with both blackish and white borders.

name: Sooretama Slaty-Antshrike
rangeDescription: Coastal southeastern brazil (southern bahia and espírito santo to rio de janeiro)
description: Small antshrike found in the lower and middle level of woodlands and second growth. Males are gray with a dark cap and black wings and tail that have prominent white bars and spots.

name: Northern Red Bishop
rangeDescription: Southern mauritania southward to northern liberia, eastward to eritrea, ethiopia, northwestern and southern somalia, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, and kenya
description: A very small gregarious species of open habitats including agricultural areas and the edges of marshes; often found in flocks of tens to hundreds. Note the black face and crown, brown wings, and long reddish orange uppertail coverts (concealing black tail) of breeding male.

name: Costa Rican Swift
rangeDescription: Southwestern costa rica and western panama
description: Smallest swift in most of range. All dark gray with contrasting pale rump and paler throat, both of which can be difficult to see in many viewing conditions.

name: Long-tailed Ground Dove
rangeDescription: West-central brazil (mato grosso) and adjacent bolivia
description: Unmistakable ground dove. Brownish above and whitish below.

name: Rufous-bellied Kookaburra
rangeDescription: Lowlands of new guinea, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea), aru islands (off southwestern new guinea), and yapen (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A distinctive large kingfisher of lowland forest. Black cap, white collar, blue wing and rump, and rufous belly.

name: Beesley's Lark
rangeDescription: Northern tanzania (near kingerete, arusha, just north of mount meru)
description: A sociable upright lark with a short decurved bill and a diagnostic short white-tipped tail. The upperparts are dark and scaly; the throat and eyebrow are paler than the warm ear patch and buffy underparts.

name: Tristram's Bunting
rangeDescription: Siberia to northeastern china; winters to southern china and northern thailand
description: Small and distinctive bunting, usually seen moving around quietly in thick undergrowth. Warm rusty brown with a black-and-white striped head.

name: Andean Ibis
rangeDescription: Andes of ecuador to far northern chile
description: Large, boldly patterned, and often noisy ibis. Uncommon and local.

name: Fiji White-eye
rangeDescription: Fiji (viti levu, ovalau, gau, vanua levu, taveuni, and kadavu)
description: A small, mostly citrine-yellow bird with a pale buffy-gray belly, a bold white eye-ring, and a black line from eye to bill. Bill dark.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Hartlaub's Gull
rangeDescription: Coastal southwestern namibia to southwestern south africa
description: A medium-sized, pale-gray-backed gull of coastal waters and human settlements. Breeding birds have dark eyes and a very faint chalky-gray hood, which non-breeding birds lack.

name: Short-billed Miner
rangeDescription: Breeds southern chile and southern argentina; winters northward to mendoza
description: Breeds in Tierra del Fuego and adjacent southern Patagonia; migrates north in winter. Favors open shrub steppe, grassy areas, and gravel roadsides.

name: Littoral Rock-Thrush
rangeDescription: Arid littoral of southwestern madagascar
description: Chunky, mid-sized robin-like bird. Males are pale gray and orange, while females are gray-brown.

name: Kadavu Fantail
rangeDescription: Kadavu (fiji)
description: Mouse-brown above and white below. Head brown with a white throat above a variable black band.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Mugimaki Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern siberia, sakhalin, and northeastern china; winters to southeastern asia and indonesia
description: Chunky, round-headed flycatcher with an orange front in all plumages. Adult male has vivid orange throat and breast contrasting with black upperparts and white belly, supercilium, and wing patches.

name: Red-throated Tit
rangeDescription: Acacia savanna of southern kenya and northern tanzania
description: An unusual tit with a rufous face, collar, and breast and a gray cap and back. Also note the prominent white wingbars on the gray wings.

name: Watercock
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern and eastern asia and malay archipelago
description: Large, distinctive marsh dweller, elusive and often difficult to see in the heavily vegetated wet fields and marshes it inhabits. Male is unmistakable, with black body, brown-edged wing coverts, and red-and-yellow bill with raised, spiky red frontal shield (unlike smaller moorhen).

name: Sira Tanager
rangeDescription: Andes of eastern peru (cerros del sira in eastern huánuco)
description: Small tanager known only from Cerros del Sira, a remote ridge east of the main chain of the Andes in central Peru. Male has a turquoise throat surrounded by black coloration extending to the crown and belly; the back, wings, and sides are light blue.

name: Red-backed Shrike
rangeDescription: Widespread palearctic region; winters to south africa
description: Handsome small shrike. Male distinctive, with blue-gray head, black mask, rusty-brown back; female has warm brown upperparts, fine dark scalloping on breast and flanks.

name: Kerguelen Petrel
rangeDescription: Tristan da cunha, gough, prince edward, crozet, and kerguelen islands
description: Dark ash-gray petrel of cold southern seas. Small- and stout-bodied overall, but with a large, “puffy”-looking head.
